paper.title: Accurate and Robust Stellar Rotation Periods catalog for 82771 Kepler stars using deep learning

result.summary: 本文提出了 LightPred，一个从 Kepler 光变曲线中提取恒星自转周期的深度学习模型，采用 LSTM 与 Transformer 双分支架构，并先以自监督对比学习在 Kepler 数据上预训练、再用模拟光变曲线做监督训练 [abstract][S1.p3][S3.SS1.p2][S3.SS1.p3][S4.SS2.p1]。在模拟数据上，LightPred 在准确率和平均误差上优于 ACF 等经典方法，并能给出置信度估计 [abstract][S5.SS1.p2][S5.SS1.p3]。作者将其应用于 Kepler 数据，经过多步筛选后给出 82771 条可靠的自转周期预测，构成迄今最大的此类星表 [abstract][S5.SS3.p2]。分析还确认了轨道周期短于 10 天的食双星存在潮汐同步，并显示模型置信度可用于区分不同恒星类型、过滤假阳性 [abstract][S5.SS2.SSS4.p5][S6.p3]。

research_question.text: 论文要解决的是如何从 Kepler 光变曲线中准确、稳健地测量大量恒星的自转周期 [S1.p1][S1.p3]。经典方法（如 Lomb-Scargle 周期图和自相关函数）虽然成功，但耗时、难以应用于大规模数据集，且常难以处理具有多个周期或演化黑子图案的复杂光变曲线 [S1.p2]。作者指出经典方法的一个缺点是难以给出预测的不确定度估计，而这对评估结果可靠性至关重要 [S1.SS1.p1]。

evidence.quote: The study of stellar rotation periods has become increasingly important in our understanding of stellar evolution, activity cycles, and exoplanet detection.
Classical methods for measuring rotation periods, such as Lomb-Scargle periodograms and autocorrelation functions, have been successful
but can be time-consuming and challenging to apply to large datasets.
Furthermore, these methods often struggle with complex light curves that exhibit multiple periodicities or evolving spot patterns.
In this paper, we present a novel deep-learning approach for measuring stellar rotation periods using Kepler light curves.
One shortcoming of classical methods is their inability to provide uncertainty estimates for predictions, which are essential for evaluating the reliability of the results.

method.text: LightPred 采用双分支架构：时间分支以 Diff-ACF 为输入，包含卷积嵌入块、双向 LSTM 块和非可学习自注意力块；全局分支以 Diff-Lc 为输入，基于修改后的 AstroConformer（用一次卷积加一次多头自注意力替代原两次卷积）[S3.SS1.p2][S3.SS1.p3]。两分支特征拼接后送入预测头，输出自转周期、倾角以及各自的置信度分数 [S3.SS1.p4]。训练采用两步流程：先在 Kepler 样本上做自监督对比学习（SSL），再用模拟光变曲线做监督训练（SBSL）[S4.SS2.p1]。模拟数据由 Butterpy 基于简化黑子模型生成，并注入真实 Kepler 噪声 [S2.SS1.p1][S2.SS2.p1]。

evidence.quote: Temporal branch - consists of an ”embedding” convolution block with max pool, dropout, batch normalization, skip connection, a bi-directional LSTM block, and a non-learnable self-attention block.
Global branch - here we follow the recent work of called Astroconformer.
in the conformer block, instead of 2 convolution layers after the multi-head self-attention (MHSA), we used one convolution and another MHSA.
The output of the model is four numbers: rotation period, inclination, period confidence score, and inclination confidence score.
To train the model, we used a 2-step pipeline; First, we trained the model, without the prediction head, in a self-supervised fashion, with Kepler samples.
Next, we used the weights from the SSL Step as an initialization for supervised training with the mock dataset.
To create a dataset for supervised training we used simulated light curves using Butterpy, a python package described in.
Next, we injected noise from real Kepler data.

experiments.text: 作者在模拟数据上进行了消融实验，比较完整模型、去掉 Diff-Lc/Diff-ACF 的版本、仅时间分支、仅 Conformer 分支以及不预测倾角的版本，评价指标为 10% 绝对误差内的样本比例 [S4.SS3.p1]。为与已有工作比较，作者另生成 50000 个采用相同先验分布的模拟样本，并使用 acc10p、acc20p 和平均绝对误差（天）作为指标 [S5.SS1.p1]。在 Kepler 数据上，作者使用 Data Release 25 长 cadence 数据，剔除 Q0-Q2 和 Q17，采用 PDC-MAP 校正，最终用于 SSL 和推断的样本为 130868 个 [S2.SS3.p1][S5.SS2.p1]。推断时先筛选 Teff<7000K 得到 126029 个样本，再剔除已知污染源后剩 108096 个样本 [S5.SS2.SSS1.p1]。

evidence.quote: The metric we used to evaluate the models is the 10 percent accuracy - the percentage of points with predictions within 10% absolute error from the ground truth.
LightPred no-diff: The same as LightPred with a change in the pre-processing; instead of using Diff-Lc and Diff-ACF, we used the regular light curve and ACF.
LightPred period only: the same as LightPred but without inclination predictions.
To compare our results with we created another 50000 samples dataset, this time with the same prior distributions as in.
We also adopted the same metrics - the percentage of samples that lie within 10% error ( acc10p) and the percentage of samples that lie within 20% error ( acc20p).
First, we downloaded the long cadence Kepler dataset Data Release 25.
we omitted Q0-Q2 and Q17 and used the data corrected for instrumental systematic using PDC-MAP
This left us with 130868 which serves both for the SSL step and the inference.
Out of the 130868 predictions we filtered out stars with $Teff<7000K$ which gave us 126029 samples.
this leaves us with 108096 samples.

findings.text: 在模拟数据上，LightPred 在噪声和无噪声样本上的表现均优于 Tel-Aviv 团队报告的 ACF 结果 [S5.SS1.p2]。与作者自己实现的 ACF 和 GPS 相比，ACF 和 GPS 实际只预测了约 85% 的数据集，而 LightPred 预测了全部样本；在 ACF 可有效预测的子集上，两者 acc10p 和 acc20p 相当，但 LightPred 平均误差显著更低，且 LightPred 在所有方面都优于 GPS [S5.SS1.p2]。模型置信度与绝对误差呈高置信度对应低误差的趋势，说明模型能判断哪些样本更难预测 [S5.SS1.p3]。在 Kepler 数据上，LightPred 的观测误差分布比 ACF 更集中，全样本下误差更低；在 ACF 有效子集上两者误差相当，LightPred 略低，相对观测误差平均均为 11% [S5.SS2.SSS2.p2]。自监督预训练显著改善 Kepler 数据上的观测误差（约降低 3 倍）[S5.SS2.SSS2.p3]。分析食双星发现，轨道周期在 3 到 10 天之间的黑子调制样本接近同步线，而 P_orb<3 天和 P_orb>10 天不显示同步 [S5.SS2.SSS4.p5]。最终经过筛选得到 82771 条可靠预测 [S5.SS3.p2]。

evidence.quote: It can be seen that our results are better for both noisy and noiseless samples.
It can be seen that both ACF and GPS predicted effectively $\sim 85\%$ of the dataset while our model predicted the entire dataset.
For a subset of valid predictions, we see that the performance of ACF is comparable to our model in terms of acc10p and acc20p but our model shows significantly lower average error.
In the case of GPS, our model is better in all aspects for both the entire dataset and the subset of valid predictions.
The trend of high confidence and low error, which can be easily seen in the figure, implies that the model was able to infer which samples are ”harder” for it to determine the stellar properties.
Our model shows more concentrated distributions and when considering the entire samples (left panel), our model has much lower error.
When considering only ACF-valid samples (right panel), The errors are comparable, with LightPred error slightly lower than ACF error.
When considering the relative observational error (dividing by the predicted period) we get the same error on average (11%).
While the improvement on simulation metrics is modest, the improvement on Kepler data is significant ( $\sim 3$ times lower observational error).
For $3<P_{orb}<10$, sp samples are very close to the synchronization line (the gray line at $P_{orb}/P_{rot}=1$) as expected.
For $P_{orb}<3$ Days and $P_{orb}>10$ Days we do not see synchronization.
This procedure left us with 82771 reliable predictions.

limitations.text: 作者承认模拟所基于的黑子模型存在倾角与黑子位置之间的内在简并，且模型依赖先验分布，黑子分布对结果影响很大 [S2.SS1.p1]。作者指出恒星倾角测定比自转周期测定更困难，因此本文只研究周期预测，将倾角作为辅助变量，留待未来工作 [S2.SS1.p2]。在数据增强中，打乱季度可能移除相位信息并妨碍长周期探测，但作者认为其泛化收益大于潜在代价 [S2.SS3.p1]。作者还指出，对于 P_orb<3 天的极快自转体，模型存在局限 [S5.SS2.SSS4.p5]。此外，对于 w>0.7 的样本，总误差与 w 呈现相反趋势，作者表示这一行为尚未完全理解 [S5.SS2.SSS3.p3]。

evidence.quote: The suggested model implies an inherent degeneracy between inclination and spot location.
This implies that the model is prior-depended: the distribution of spots in the model has a large effect on the results.
We therefore treat inclination and period predictions separately; in this paper, we investigate the period predictions and treat inclinations as an auxiliary variable
We acknowledge that shuffling quarters (90 Days) might remove phase information and potentially hinder the detection of long periods.
While the latter is expected, the former can be assigned to the limitations of the model with very fast rotators, exactly as we saw in Figure 9.
For $w>0.7$ there is interesting behavior with an opposite trend which is not fully understood.
